world.description: A walled desert citadel at golden hour, built from scratch with no library models: sand-plaster houses with domes and minarets on a rise above a palm-ringed oasis lake, a striped-awning market square, stepped lanes, windmills on the ridge, a stone aqueduct running from the ridge into the lake, and a caravan camp of Bedouin tents and camels below the main gate.

start.text: Saffron, cumin, dates from the oasis! The caravans came in at noon.
Forty days across the sands, and the citadel walls still glow like gold at dusk.

intent.text: golden hour: honey-lit sandstone, long plum shadows, warm dusty haze

bedouin-tent.description: Low, wide Bedouin black tent: a striped woven roof sagging between poles along a ridge line, open front (+Z) raised on short poles, closed back and back-half side curtains, guy ropes to stakes, a rug and cushions inside.

camel.description: Dromedary camel standing, facing +X, ~2.2 m at the hump: deep barrel body with a single hump, long thin legs with knobbly knees and backward hocks, broad pads, a long S-curved neck, a long muzzle, ears and tail, a woven saddle blanket and bags.

cart.description: Detailed wooden hand cart with a planked bed, raised side rails, iron-rimmed spoked wheels, axle hardware and two long pull handles.

castle-gate.description: A detailed medieval stone castle gatehouse with twin crenellated towers, a deep arched passage, iron portcullis, battlements, wall walk, arrow slits, and rear-facing architectural detail.

desert-house.description: Flat-roofed sand-plaster desert house with parapet, arched door (+Z), small dark windows, optional dome on a drum or a rooftop stair hut.

fountain.description: Tiered stone fountain with a round basin, pedestal, upper bowl and shimmering water.

market-stall.description: Market stall: wooden posts, counter at +Z with heaped wares, back table with jars, sloping striped canopy and scalloped valance.

minaret.description: Slender octagonal desert minaret: square plinth, banded shaft with slit windows, balcony, arcaded lantern, onion-ish dome and gold finial.

oasis-land.description: Desert heightfield: citadel plateau (y=8) centred (0,-25) with a clear rise, windmill ridge (y=14) along z=-78, oasis lake basin at the east foot of the rise (50,-4), packed-earth road ramp from the caravan camp (-14,31) up to the main gate (0,6), dunes and far hills. Lowest point = lake bottom (place entity at y=-2).

world.name: Desert Citadel
